channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Al Horford | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Al Horford from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Al Horford, Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Jaylen Brown on beating Warriors’ Al Horford and Kristaps Porzingis tonight:

“Those guys helped me win a championship in 2024, so no better way than to respect them than giving them the belt tonight.”

Jaylen Brown on Al Horford, Kristaps Porzingis, Feb 20, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Al Horford
item.description:
‪Jack Simone‬:Joe Mazzulla on Al Horford:

“At the end of the day, just grateful that I got to coach him, but more grateful- He's obviously, to me, a Hall-of-Famer, and he's one of the guys when I first got the job that he had my back. And I think that says a lot about who he is as a veteran.”

Joe Mazzulla on Al Horford, Feb 20, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Draymond Green on Al Horford
item.description:
Draymond Green on Al Horford:

“Tank God for Al. The five can be a tough position when you’re when you’re playing the five you’re in every action even if you’re not trying to be, because you are the last line like you have to anchor everything and you have to hold it down right like as the five if you can’t hold it down your team gets run over.”

Draymond Green on Al Horford, Oct 17, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jordan Walsh on Al Horford
item.description:
Jordan Walsh on Al Horford:

“I mean, he’s really smart. He has a lot of like random general knowledge about stuff. Like we do this trivia every day, game days, and he’s like killing it, like every time. He’s always—like every month we have a ranking—he’s always the top. Like he just has—his random knowledge of the most random stuff is crazy. So it’s fun to get—just get random tidbits from him. It’s hilarious.”

Jordan Walsh on Al Horford, Jun 25, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Al Horford
item.description:
Mazzulla:

“A stat sheet doesn't always show what (Horford) does for us ... he was just elite ... his positioning, his physicality ... it was amazing to watch.”

Joe Mazzulla on Al Horford, Mar 2, 2025. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Guerschon Yabusele on Al Horford
item.description:
“I remember when I was talking to some of the vets like Al Horford, he was talking to me and giving me advice. So I still have those little things here running in my head. I know it’s gonna be a long season and just gotta be focused and do your thing.”

Guerschon Yabusele on Al Horford, Aug 30, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Wyc Grousbeck on Al Horford
item.description:
“Al Horford s coming back for next year. That’s what I’ve been told. Age 38, which is unbelievable,”

Wyc Grousbeck on Al Horford, Jun 20, 2024. Source: Audacy.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Al Horford
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Joe Mazzulla on Al Horford stepping up as Horford turns 38 during the Finals:

“You can’t really put it into words. I’ll try my best. He’s just a guy who is the best.”

Joe Mazzulla on Al Horford, May 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Al Horford
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Joe Mazzulla on Al Horford's performance:

“The theme of this team is they generate a lot of chaos and noise ... they want you to be scrambled in what you can live with and what you take away... the most important thing ... is what's great defense regardless of the result.”

Joe Mazzulla on Al Horford, May 22, 2024. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: DaRon Holmes on Al Horford, Draymond Green, Aaron Gordon, Nikola Jokic, Naz Reid
item.description:
DaRon Holmes:

“I like guys like Naz Reid, Al Horford, Nikola Jokic and Aaron Gordon. I take different things from different guys. Defensively, Draymond Green because he’s not the biggest, fastest, or strongest, but he’s smart. He knows how to play in pick-and-roll coverage and uses his mouth to be vocal.”

DaRon Holmes on Al Horford, Draymond Green, Aaron Gordon, Nikola Jokic, Naz Reid, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Al Horford
item.description:
Tatum on Horford:

“I give Al a lot of credit, how he's transitioned and adapted his game to ... still have a huge impact. I've watched Al, how professional he is, how he carries himself, how he takes care of his body. I've stolen a lot of things from Al ... having a routine ... a plan for how you're gonna get better today.”

Jayson Tatum on Al Horford, May 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Al Horford
item.description:
Billy Donovan on Horford at 37:

“I was very blessed and fortunate to be around him when he was young ... as a teammate, he's phenomenal ... there's no personal intention about him other than to win.”

Billy Donovan on Al Horford, Feb 22, 2024. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Al Horford
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Mark Daigneault on Al Horford:

“I told him this multiple times… but every 1st year NBA head coach should be as lucky as I was to have Al Horford.”

Mark Daigneault on Al Horford, Jan 2, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Al Horford
item.description:
Jayson Tatum on Al Horford:

“As I've gotten older, our relationship has grown. It's based off respect and the respect that I have for him, and likewise. We know we need each other.”

Jayson Tatum on Al Horford, Nov 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Al Horford
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Tatum on Horford:

“Someone that really took me under his wing...periodically and randomly throughout my first year would ask me how I'm doing, how I'm adjusting.”

Jayson Tatum on Al Horford, Nov 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Al Horford
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Joe Mazzulla on the decision to bring Al Horford off the bench:

“You don't make decisions without taking in consideration who he is and what he stands for. I'm not saying he lined up, shit, like raising his hand excited about it. But he's Al, so we're grateful for him.”

Joe Mazzulla on Al Horford, Oct 25, 2023. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Kevin Love on Al Horford, Marcus Smart, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Turning to the present, Love said of the Celts,

“This is a very good team, a very good culture. I mean, we really respect the hell out of them. They’ve really got something special over there, a deep team, very well balanced, guys that were on All-Defense.“Al Horford, who’s had an unbelievable career, just holds it down at the power forward/center position. Marcus Smart won Defensive Player of the Year last year. You’ve got two superstar guys in (Jayson) Tatum and (Jaylen) Brown. I mean, just really the entire lineup.”

Kevin Love on Al Horford, Marcus Smart, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, May 19, 2023. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Robert Williams on Al Horford
item.description:
Jay King:Robert Williams on how Al Horford stopped practice yesterday:

“That’s all the time. He’s always on our ass when we need it.”

Robert Williams on Al Horford, May 17, 2023. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Malcolm Brogdon on Al Horford
item.description:
Malcolm Brogdon:

“I think the guy we followed all season, our leader is Al Horford.”

Malcolm Brogdon on Al Horford, May 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: PJ Tucker on Al Horford
item.description:
“Nobody can guard Jo one on one. It's not disrespect to Al [Horford]…When he's aggressive and assertive, it's impossible, and I seen him two plays in a row not do that. And we can't have that. Not with the season on the line.”

PJ Tucker on Al Horford, May 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Al Horford
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Jayson Tatum on Al Horford:

“Whoever laughed at him earlier, shame on you. Al is definitely an elite shooter and he's been that and proven that. He is so important to what we are trying to accomplish as a team.”

Jayson Tatum on Al Horford, May 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Al Horford
item.description:
Jaylen Brown on Al Horford:

“Can’t say enough about Al. Al’s a professional. He does it on both ends. He makes timely shots, timely plays, timely rebounds. And he’s probably one of the best off-court leaders in the NBA.”

Jaylen Brown on Al Horford, Apr 15, 2023. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Draymond Green on Al Horford
item.description:
“I remember very, very, very clearly, Al Horford, in Game 1 of the NBA Finals when [the Boston Celtics] made they come back, and he got an 'and-1,' and he's flexing right in my face. Nobody said a word. ... But now Angel does it, and it's a ‘problem.’”

Draymond Green on Al Horford, Apr 6, 2023. Source: FOXnews.com.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Al Horford
item.description:
John Karalis:Jaylen Brown on Al Horford:

“Mi hermano. That's my brother. I love Al. He has been able to be a great mentor in my life,be able to help me not just on the court, but off the court. Just a great role model for anybody.”

Jaylen Brown on Al Horford, Feb 18, 2023. Source: Twitter @John_Karalis.

item.title: Mike Muscala on Al Horford
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Muscala on Friday:

“I came to Atlanta when I was young, so just learning from (Horford), seeing his work ethic, his consistency, just being a great leader, being so consistent. It's really great to have a familiar face in him.”

Mike Muscala on Al Horford, Feb 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Al Horford
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Joe Mazzulla on Al Horford:

“I thought he played a lot last night, played the whole fourth ... he woke up this morning and just didn't feel right.”

Joe Mazzulla on Al Horford, Oct 22, 2022. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Isaiah Stewart on Al Horford, Robert Williams, Jalen Duren
item.description:
Asked Weaver how Duren fits with Isaiah Stewart:

“They’re different. (Duren) is bigger. His presence is more pronounced. Isaiah has shown to be able to shoot the 3 more. They can play together. Horford and Robert Williams played together … I don’t see it as a challenge.”

Isaiah Stewart on Al Horford, Robert Williams, Jalen Duren, Jun 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Al Horford, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
“I mean I love Golden State. I think they’re gonna win, but theCeltics got so much–like they got Jaylen Brown, they got Jayson Tatum, they got Al Horf. If Al Horford plays how he’s been playing, I don’t think the Warriors got a chance,”

Anthony Edwards on Al Horford, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Jun 11, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Al Horford
item.description:
Keith Smith:Jaylen Brown:

“Nobody deserves it more than this guy (motions to Al Horford). I'm proud and happy to share the moment with someone like him.”

Jaylen Brown on Al Horford, May 30, 2022. Source: Twitter @KeithSmithNBA.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Al Horford, Ime Udoka
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on illness starting to affect availability in this series with Horford in protocol and Udoka sick:

“It’s really disappointing. Every time you think it’s behind us, it’s not and it’s really frustrating for us. You don’t want to see it on both sides.”

Erik Spoelstra on Al Horford, Ime Udoka, May 18, 2022. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.
